mathematical_findings.reason: For r,s prime and r<=s, ChenPrimeRough(p2,r*s) iff p2<=r because each prime divisor equals r or s. From an actual quotient witness, q<N and Coprime q N; r,s divide q, so both r,s<N and coprime to N. Thus using chenAdditivePrimeCarrier N for r,s in the literal definition is merely a finite carrier, not an added arithmetic restriction. Conversely the stated RHS yields the original q-source by P=N-b*q and exact Nat subtraction/division; then carrier membership follows from source data.
q=1 is sifted vacuously and can occur under every original Y7 selector/source gate. The N=76,P=61,p1=3,p2=5 control proves it cannot be discarded based on the sqrt cap.
r=s and r=p2 must both remain. q prime can equal p2 as well. Integer-boundary equality cannot be removed by a null-wall argument about continuous integrals.

Existing ordered_prime_factors_unique has the exact weak r<=s ordering and equality-of-products conclusion, including squares. Multiplication from sorted prime pairs is injective. Products are neither prime nor one by prime factors >=2, so the three row branches are disjoint and exhaustive.

For each original t=(p1,p2), quotient source image is injective in its original additive-prime P label, already proved by chenQuotientPrimeSource_injective. Sigma labels retain each t across all three branches; cardinal_sigma sums the same row counts. Do not replace the outer Sigma by a product image, divide pair counts by2, delete diagonal squares, or multiply these arithmetic cardinalities by a sieve density. The finite equality is in Real after Nat casts only. H(N)=singularNormalization N enters later mean inequalities, not this exact partition.

sievePrimes N z uses ell<z and excludes ell|N. Existing chenPrimeRough_iff_coprime_sieveProduct requires Coprime q N, which actual quotient source supplies. At z=(p2:Real), ceil(z)=p2; equality ell=p2 is retained in roughness. This correctly normalizes the finite sieve mask, and supplies no analytic distribution or Buchstab mean.

Actual manuscript and current ledger weight use -2*Y7. The proposed equality partitions Upsilon7 itself; the factor2 is only applied when integrating the full lower-bound ledger, never inserted into a branch cardinality.
